title: LLMEval: A Preliminary Study on How to Evaluate Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its benchmarks, LLMEval-1 and LLMEval-2, focus on general cognitive abilities (e.g., reasoning, translation, summarization) and knowledge in 12 academic subjects (e.g., chemistry, law, computer science), none of which include religious studies or theology.
findings: The paper does not contain any analysis or findings related to religion or faith.
